excludedPredicates.dealtWith: the negation of leftAlone: would duplicate it
excludedPredicates.couldBeResponsible: a helper for work judgement labels, not a social fact
excludedPredicates.change: any polarity would judge whether an outcome was good or bad for an agent (minimal strategy interference)
excludedPredicates.points: a mirrored work score: same reason as change

notConsidered.responsible: alone it has no polarity; it gets one with the label (tier 2: judgedAs ^ responsible)
notConsidered.role: work occurrences carry no roles; on social occurrences, being the one talked about is not something ?SELF witnessed, and being confided in needs the speaker (tier 2)
notConsidered.judgedAs careless: no clear single-premise effect on ?SELF's own charity or reserve
notConsidered.leftAlone(?B): ?SELF can't know nobody did anything to ?B

notes: Every stage binds the agent choosing as ?SELF; RUE keeps same-type variables distinct, so rules are written about ?SELF.
judgedAs label slots must be literals: a variable there matches nothing (labels are strings, not entities).
Label rules use [asserted-during: 2] (this round and last) so permanent label records don't pile up over a long run.
First pass chosen without item-by-item review (Mike, Nov 7: he reviews later).

queue.ruleName: likes them: inclined to believe them
queue.ruleText:
rule "likes them: inclined to believe them"
    ?SELF.likes(?SELF, ?B) > 5
    => impulse-trusting(?SELF, ?B) += 1

queue.ruleName: dislikes them: inclined to doubt them
queue.ruleText:
rule "dislikes them: inclined to doubt them"
    ?SELF.likes(?SELF, ?B) < 5
    => impulse-wary(?SELF, ?B) += 1

rule "trusts them: warms to them"
    ?SELF.trusts(?SELF, ?B) > 5
    => impulse-warm(?SELF, ?B) += 1

rule "each colleague liked: more charitable"
    ?SELF.likes(?SELF, ?OTHER) > 5
    => impulse-charitable(?SELF) += 1

rule "each colleague distrusted: more guarded"
    ?SELF.trusts(?SELF, ?OTHER) < 5
    => impulse-reserved(?SELF) += 1

queue.ruleName: called something selfish lately: less charitable
queue.ruleText:
rule "called something selfish lately: less charitable"
    ?SELF.judgedAs(?O, "selfish") [asserted-during: 2]
    => impulse-charitable(?SELF) -= 1

queue.ruleName: called something fair lately: more charitable

queue.ruleName: left alone this round: more reserved
queue.ruleText:
rule "left alone this round: more reserved"
    leftAlone(?SELF)
    => impulse-reserved(?SELF) += 1
